scope: Route active combat, social, crafting, and camping rewards to their explicit Publish 14 XP pools, keep skill-box acquisition separate from XP accumulation, and preserve the authentic owner-only camp lifecycle instead of converting camp XP into scout XP at login.

core3Evidence.combat: PlayerManagerImplementation::disseminateExperience awards each threat-map weapon XP type directly and separately awards combat_general.
core3Evidence.crafting: CraftingSessionImplementation awards the completed schematic's xpType directly.
core3Evidence.training: SkillManager::awardSkill independently validates prerequisites and consumes the selected skill's XP cost.

campXpContract.awardFormula: int(baseXp * durationScale) + int((uniqueVisitors - 1) * int(baseXp / 30) * durationScale) + int(accumulatedHealingXp * durationScale)
campXpContract.uniqueVisitorRule: Each distinct player object other than the owner contributes at most once even after leaving and re-entering; the owner is the implicit first occupant and is not a visitor bonus.
campXpContract.healingEventRule: For each native damage-healing observer event explicitly requested with a valid healer while the healed player is currently inside this maintained camp, immediately add int(baseXp / 180) to the camp's accumulated healing XP; count the authored event even when the clamped applied delta is zero. Payout applies the duration scale to that accumulated healing XP.
campXpContract.ownerExitGraceRule: Owner exit keeps the camp in STATUS_MAINTAIN and schedules a sequence-bound 60-second grace callback. Only the matching still-current callback may transition to abandoned, zero accrued credit, and select a no-award cleanup path; owner reentry invalidates the pending callback. Natural expiry during the grace window remains award-bearing.
campXpContract.atMostOnce: The claim marker is written before the owner XP grant and every later claim attempt returns without granting.

sourceHashPolicy.xp.java: historical-milestone-hash; cumulative acceptance is behavioral because later retirement patches share the XP library
sourceHashPolicy.base_player.java: historical-milestone-hash; cumulative acceptance is behavioral because later progression-boundary patches share OnInitialize

runtimeBoundary.combat: weapon and broad combat XP accumulate without a working class template
runtimeBoundary.social: music, dance, juggling, entertainer, and image-designer XP accumulate by explicit type
runtimeBoundary.crafting: schematic XP accumulates by explicit type without an NGE trader multiplier or merchant-template exchange
runtimeBoundary.training: trainSkill remains the only normal skill-box acquisition boundary

requiredBeforeReady: Pass a clean canonical Docker x86-64 Java/native build and cumulative artifact probe.
Restart the canonical x64 server and capture healthy player-readiness evidence for the rebuilt binaries.
